title: rhus magalismontana subsp. trifoliolata
intro: Rhus magalismontana subsp. trifoliolata, commonly known as the Mountain Sumac, is a plant species in the Anacardiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that provide several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sumac include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Sumac also exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic activities, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
